server.name: s4pc-mcp
server.description: S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition clean-core MCP server (offline-first, zero-dependency)

mode.comment: offline = catalog + lint + advisor only (no network). live = adds read-only OData access to the tenant using a communication user. Overridable via env S4PC_MODE.

deploy.comment: Side-by-side BTP deploy (btp_deploy tool). OFF by default. Deploys to dev/test Cloud Foundry spaces only; production-looking names are blocked; dry-run (build only) unless explicitly disabled. Credentials come only from CF_* environment variables.

sap.comment: Live-mode connection settings come ONLY from environment variables so no secret ever lands in a file: SAP_BASE_URL (e.g. https://myXXXXXX-api.s4hana.cloud.sap), SAP_COMM_USER, SAP_COMM_PASSWORD. TLS verification is always on.
